integrity: The arbitrary-n result is proved symbolically. A standalone verifier exhaustively checks small graphs and separately confirms the word-chain formulas over a wider finite suite.
scientific_limitations: The exact polynomial is a weighted multiset-permutation sum and may require coefficient collection for a desired canonical sparse form.
The theorem is specific to cozero-divisor graphs of integer residue rings.
The 2026 follow-up was compared from its abstract because a full public copy was not available in the inspected sources.
title: Maximal divisor chains determine independent domination in every cozero-divisor graph \(\Gamma'(\mathbb Z_n)\)
